subject: Post-call: stakeholder roster & legal/procurement queue
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Samir Kapadia <sam.kapadia@avatech.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 07 Mar 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap: next steps on stakeholders & procurement

Hi Samir —

Thanks for taking the time earlier. Quick recap and concrete next steps so we stay aligned:

- Outcome: AvaTech is interested in a pilot for 6k requests/day supporting customer support triage.
- Decision criteria you mentioned: latency under 300ms p50, SOC2 attestation, and a clear PO path.
- Economic buyer: you indicated Elena Rossi (Head of Product) will sign off on budget.

Immediate asks (can you confirm by EOD Wednesday?):
1) Confirm the procurement contact (name + email) who handles vendor onboarding/POs.
2) Confirm which legal/IT security documents your team requires (e.g., SOC 2, DPA, security questionnaire).
3) Target go-live timeframe for pilot and any blackout dates for procurement this quarter.

I'll loop in our security and procurement liaisons once you confirm contacts. Attaching the high-level pilot SOW and a lightweight vendor checklist so your team can preview what's typically requested.

Best,

Jonas Weber
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com | (415) 555-0123

Attachments: Redwood_SOW_v1.pdf (overview), avn_vendor_onboarding_checklist.xlsx (sample)

From: Samir Kapadia <sam.kapadia@avatech.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: AvaTech Procurement <procurement_ops@avatech.com>
Date: Mon, 08 Mar 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: next steps on stakeholders & procurement

Thanks Jonas —

Appreciate the clear notes. Quick answers:
- Procurement lead: Priya Menon (procurement_ops@avatech.com) — I've cc'd the general procurement mailbox; Priya will follow up.
- Legal/security: we will need SOC2 Type II, a redline-able Master Services Agreement, and completion of our vendor security questionnaire (I'll send the form).
- Timeline: procurement reviews typically take 2–3 weeks after we receive complete docs; Elena will review budget next Tuesday (2027-03-16).

Priya — can you confirm preferred PO terms (Net30 vs Net45) and whether a PO is required to begin the pilot?

Samir
Head of Infrastructure | AvaTech
sam.kapadia@avatech.com

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Samir Kapadia <sam.kapadia@avatech.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, AvaTech Procurement <procurement_ops@avatech.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Mar 2027 11:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: next steps on stakeholders & procurement

Great — thanks for the quick turnaround, Samir.

To make procurement/IT review as frictionless as possible, could you please:
- Attach Priya's contact or confirm whether procurement_ops routes to her directly.
- Share the vendor security questionnaire (if you already have a link to a doc or a PDF, that'll speed things up).
- Confirm whether SOC2 attestation can be accepted in lieu of a full security assessment; we have a redacted SOC2 Type II we can provide immediately.

For visibility internally, Marissa (Solutions Eng) and Dev (Customer Ops) will hold technical onboarding and billing questions respectively.

If procurement requires a PO before any billable activity, that's fine — please provide an expected date for PO issuance so we can schedule pilot provisioning.

I've attached a short onboarding checklist and the initial SOW draft. We'll be ready to join a procurement call if Priya wants to run through items live.

Thanks,
Jonas

Attachments: Redwood_SOW_v1.pdf, avn_vendor_onboarding_checklist.xlsx
